sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: WHAT IS CE CERTIFICATION IN INDIA?
WHY DO YOU NEED CE CERTIFICATION IN INDIA?
DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR CE CERTIFICATION IN INDIA:
HOW TO GET CE CERTIFICATE IN INDIA:

The French phrase that is abbreviated to CE means "European Conformity" (Conformité Européenne). It is a certificate that certifies a product’s environmental, health, and safety standards set by the European Union.

The CE certification in India indicates that the product has undergone testing and falls in line with the standards set by the European Union. It also ensures consumers about the safety and quality standard of the products.

By having CE certification in India, the manufacturer certifies that the product conforms to the applicable CE marking directives and EU criteria. Regulation compliance also opens the way for businesses looking to grow worldwide. Since CE certification is widely accepted as a signal of quality and safety even outside the EEA, CE certification gives the product access to markets while building customer satisfaction and confidence. It also helps the business stand out in the international market.
Essential documents required for CE certification are –
All the information about design of the product.
Descriptions and explanations to aid understanding of the drawings and schemes.
List of harmonized and non-harmonized standards applied during the conformity assessment process.
In order to get the CE certification in India, you also need to produce Test reports and risk assessment files.
Copies of conformity documentation for critical product components.
Instructions for use.
Copy of the Declaration of Conformity.

It could be a difficult task for the manufacturers, who are not well versed with the CE certification process, to get the online CE certificate. Below are the complete details of the certification process:

Find Relevant CE Marking Directives: The EU directives tell about must-have requirements about a product to enter the European Union market. CE marking directives are written in legal language; that’s why at times it is difficult to interpret them easily. In many cases, a product is regulated by more than one directive, in that case the manufacturer needs to adhere to all the relevant applicable directives to have a CE certification in India.

In addition to picking out relevant CE marking directives, businesses also have to find applicable standards in order to put their products on the market. These documents will tell you all the essential and technical requirements for a product to meet the prescribed directives regarding safety requirements of the relevant CE certification in India.

Evaluation By A Notified Body: An entity that conforms to EU regulations is known as a Notified Body, which evaluates the CE conformity of many kinds of products. These notified bodies are responsible for the conformity evaluation of the products, like a review of the technical file and conducting an examination of production facilities for issuing CE certification in India. It is not mandatory for all the products to get examined by the notified body, so as a manufacturer you must know which relevant directives are required for your products.
